mapper.select: select from ord_dir_salvage_deliv_pond where order_type_config_id = #{orderTypeConfigId} and truncation_date_time = #{truncationDateTime} and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode}

select s.id,s.order_type_config_id,s.truncation_date_time,s.salvage_time,s.salvage_status,s.wait_execution_total, s.execution_total,s.org_code, s.biz_org_code, s.creator,s.create_time, s.updater, s.update_time,s.is_delete from ord_dir_salvage_deliv_pond s INNER JOIN ( select salvage_pond_id,count(*) AS maxCount from ord_dir_salvage_deliv_pond_detail where salvage_pond_id is not null and is_delete = 0 GROUP BY salvage_pond_id ) a on a.salvage_pond_id = s.id where s.salvage_status = #{salvageStatus} and s.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and s.truncation_date_time between #{beginTime} and now() and s.execution_total < a.maxCount and s.is_delete = 0
